summary.es: Sistema que convierte cada conversación de desarrollo en conocimiento estructurado, documentación, curso interactivo y estado de proyecto ejecutable.
summary.en: System that turns every development conversation into structured knowledge, documentation, an interactive course and an executable project state.
summary.pt: Sistema que transforma cada conversa de desenvolvimento em conhecimento estruturado, documentação, curso interativo e estado de projeto executável.

north_star.es: Que ninguna sesión futura tenga que releer el universo: el proyecto se explica, se recupera, se continúa y se mejora a sí mismo.
north_star.en: No future session should have to re-read the universe: the project explains, recovers, continues and improves itself.
north_star.pt: Que nenhuma sessão futura precise reler o universo: o projeto se explica, se recupera, se continua e se melhora sozinho.

vision.central_rule: Nothing happens without leaving an observable project event.
anti_goals: Embedding LangGraph/CrewAI/AutoGen/n8n/Dify/Flowise/Langflow inside the core; they are optional adapters only.
Letting the AI rewrite entire files or the whole project instead of patching them.
Storing a literal transcription of a model's private internal reasoning.

levels.purpose: Preserve everything exactly as it happened. No interpretation.
AI/rule analysis of raw material into typed entities.
Reusable knowledge: concepts, decisions, patterns, lessons.
The real project: source, apps, packages, services, agents, skills, tests.
Operational brain: manifest, state, roadmap, tasks, checkpoints, policies.

requirements.title: Document absolutely everything that happens in the project
requirements.acceptance: Every user message, interpretation, plan, action, result, decision and lesson is persisted and queryable.

requirements.title: Separate data into five levels (raw / processed / knowledge / project / control)
requirements.acceptance: The five physical directories exist and no level writes into another.

requirements.title: Store explainable Decision Traces instead of private model reasoning
requirements.acceptance: Each decision records objective, context, constraints, alternatives, decision, justification, consequence and status.

requirements.title: Treat interruptions ('cortes') as first-class events
requirements.acceptance: Interruption events carry type, layer, task, reason, impact, recoverability and recovery plan.

requirements.title: Work fully offline with zero npm dependencies in the core
requirements.acceptance: npm install is never required to run init/capture/process/search/context/serve.

requirements.title: Web app that is simultaneously full-featured and offline-capable
requirements.acceptance: Zero-dep console works with no node_modules; Next.js app consumes the same API.

requirements.title: Trilingual pedagogical code comments (ES/EN/PT) written as a beginner course
requirements.acceptance: Every source file has a trilingual header plus a BEGINNER COURSE block.

requirements.title: Generate a Reverse Engineering Curriculum from real builds
requirements.acceptance: A completed build can be turned into lesson + concepts + tutorial + exercise + solution.

requirements.title: Autonomous agent with context, planner, executor, verifier and recovery
requirements.acceptance: genesis resume rebuilds session context and continues the last task.

requirements.title: Never overwrite: snapshot, diff, patch, verify, rollback
requirements.acceptance: Checkpoints can restore control state and are created before risky mutations.

mcp.note: MCP is treated as a pluggable adapter layer, never as a core dependency.

education.comment_policy: Every source file carries a trilingual header and a BEGINNER COURSE block explaining concepts as if the reader had never programmed before.
